summary: A very good mock: realistic flat-letting call, museum reopening talk with a well-built comment box, a two-student project discussion, and a full lecture on timekeeping. All keys are correct and the distractors are fair.
strengths: Part 1: Carlton Road vs Cardwell Street, fourth corrected to third, six million reduced to five, Friday withdrawn, driving licence refused, email rejected for text.
Part 2 box is strong: the costume gallery is "exactly the same size" (trap for "twice its previous size"), the children's room has no separate entrance (trap for that option).
Part 3 matching paraphrases the findings well ("pollution from agriculture" for "showed pollution from farming", "passed every standard" for "passed every official standard").
Part 4 notes paraphrase rather than copy for most items ("the hour was announced by a {{34}}" vs "learned the hour from a bell").

issues.problem: A few Part 1 notes repeat the script exactly (Q6 "paid by the tenant", Q9 "needed for the tenancy form", Q10 directions "sent by text").
Q35 and Q39 notes are close to the script ("a swinging {{35}} in a cathedral", "vibrations of a tiny {{39}}").
issues.change: Reword, e.g. Q39 "quartz clocks: count how often a small {{39}} vibrates".
